subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public bare-reset greeting contract should OpenClaw support across auto-reply and Gateway: acknowledgement-only, startup/model greeting, suppressible greeting, cheaper greeting model routing, prompt customization, or one typed policy that covers these modes?
rationale: The issue asks for new compatibility-sensitive config and provider/model routing behavior, while current shipped code and tests encode acknowledgement-only bare resets and related open items ask for overlapping restore or prompt customization semantics.

options.title: Choose One Typed Reset Policy
options.body: Define a single policy shape covering acknowledgement-only, startup-turn, suppress, prompt customization, and optional model override semantics, then implement it consistently across source, docs, schema, and tests.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45501 own reset prompt wording while keeping this broader model/suppress issue open for later policy work.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only As Direction
options.body: Document bare reset acknowledgement as intentional and close or narrow restore/suppress/model-routing requests toward explicit `/new <message>` or a future startup-turn command.

recommendation.title: Choose One Typed Reset Policy
recommendation.body: Define a single policy shape covering acknowledgement-only, startup-turn, suppress, prompt customization, and optional model override semantics, then implement it consistently across source, docs, schema, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to current reset-contract history and has already reviewed the issue’s remaining product decision.
